title: Personal Training Packages: prorating the effective refund percentage onto the unused-session value
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states how the refund amount is derived by combining the unused-session value with the effective refund percentage.

## Rule
The refund amount is the unused-session value multiplied by the effective refund percentage, divided by 100 to express the percentage as a proportion. This effective percentage -- not the tier's own plain base refund percentage -- is what is prorated onto the unused-session value; the two figures are multiplied together, never applied one after the other on a partial amount. The refund amount is rounded to 2 decimal places only at this final step.

## Points of judgement
The unused-session value and the effective refund percentage are each derived independently before this step: the unused-session value never itself already reflects the corporate wellness uplift, and the effective refund percentage never itself already reflects the unused-session count. Only at this final step are the two multiplied together, and only after that multiplication is the single rounding to 2 decimal places applied -- the unused-session value is never rounded on its own beforehand, and the effective percentage is never rounded on its own beforehand either.
